debrief db-021
1) the actor c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d the c-o-v-e-r-b-i-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n s and left a s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g s-h-e-e-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e b-i-d v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d a h-i-d-d-e-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t and left a b-a-n-k s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t t-r-a-i-l while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e a-u-d-i-t.
3) the actor d-e-v-e-l-o-p-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r for w-i-n-n-i-n-g t-u-r-n s and left a c-h-a-t l-o-g of b-id r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s c-h-e-c-k.
4) the actor p-r-e-s-e-n-t-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s as c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e and left a s-t-a-g-e-d e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t f-a-i-r-n-e-s-s r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the actor e-n-g-a-g-e-d c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r s in c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n and left a m-e-t-i-n-g n-o-t-e with s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g d-a-t-a while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-e-g-a-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
